##### Project general facts

Manarina by Zenith is a contemporary residential project with a refined, resort-inspired design and a strong focus on comfort, light and elegant living. It combines duplex townhouses with stylish apartments above, offering studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments with layouts designed to feel open, efficient and comfortable.

The amenities create a calm and premium lifestyle experience. A landscaped courtyard with a resort-style swimming pool, integrated loungers, shaded seating areas and lush greenery gives the project a private and relaxing atmosphere, complemented by a modern gym with cardio and strength-training equipment, a signature roof garden, planted terraces and a refined lobby with soft neutral tones and elegant architectural arches.

Interiors follow a warm and modern style, with natural wood-effect flooring, soft lighting and large glass openings that bring in plenty of natural light. Apartments include open living and dining areas, well-planned kitchens, comfortable bedrooms, modern bathrooms and generous balconies or terraces in many layouts, and are delivered semi-furnished with kitchen appliances for a polished, welcoming feel.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a strategically planned district in the southern part of Dubai, conceived as a major hub for economic, commercial and logistics activity. Its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, one of the world's largest airports by cargo volume, makes the district a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

Dubai South is home to the Expo City Dubai legacy district, which offers residential communities, educational institutions and recreational facilities alongside world-class event infrastructure. Green initiatives, eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings underline the district's commitment to sustainable living.

Dubai South is a thriving business and residential hub that attracts both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for end users and investors alike, supported by the ongoing economic diversification of Dubai.
